scenario.name: Hover exactly at 30C noise
scenario.hypothesis: No hysteresis and no debounce: tempC oscillates around 30.0 with noise, causing digitalWrite to toggle every loop iteration (~100ms). This will exceed max 2 toggles per 5s window (a2).

evidence.before: D9 toggled 31 times in a 5000 ms window starting at 4.92 s (limit 2), and 54 times over the whole 10.00 s run.
evidence.after: D9 toggled 1 time(s) in 10.00 s, within the limit of 2 per 5000 ms.

input: sensor held at the 30 °C switch-on point, with noise
